lines.text: It's two in the morning. Layla saw a ministry's ad, and asks a question they've never had a safe place to ask.
lines.cap: It's two in the morning. / Layla saw a ministry's ad, / and asks a question / they've never had / a safe place to ask.

lines.text: But messages pour in faster than a small team can answer.
lines.cap: But messages pour in / faster than a small team / can answer.

lines.text: So seekers wait. Or the ministry turns off its ad just to catch up, and the door closes.
lines.cap: So seekers wait. / Or the ministry turns off its ad / just to catch up, / and the door closes.

lines.text: The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few.
That's why we built Zogreo. It's the word Jesus used for catching people alive.
lines.cap: That's why we built Zogreo. / It's the word Jesus used / for catching people alive.

lines.text: Zogreo answers seekers day or night, in their heart language, and it's honest about the hard parts.
lines.cap: Zogreo answers seekers / day or night, / in their heart language, / and it's honest / about the hard parts.

lines.text: And when someone is ready for a real person, it brings in a trained believer from a local ministry.
lines.cap: And when someone is ready / for a real person, / it brings in / a trained believer / from a local ministry.

lines.text: In a weeklong pilot in Turkey, Zogreo helped a two-person team serve 3.73 times as many seekers.
lines.cap: In a weeklong pilot in Turkey, / Zogreo helped / a two-person team serve / 3.73 times as many seekers.

lines.text: Zogreo doesn't replace missionaries. It multiplies them.
lines.cap: Zogreo doesn't replace / missionaries. / It multiplies them.

lines.text: Your gift puts that conversation within reach of someone who has never had a safe place to ask.
lines.cap: Your gift puts that conversation / within reach of someone / who has never had / a safe place to ask.
